SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No.
S.1, Special Branch.    40
REPORT
Date ____ October 19, 1937.
Subject ____ Commemoration of the death of Loo Sing (鲁迅), the late left-wing writer.
Made by Clerk Liao Chung Chien    Forwarded by [签名]

between 1.30 p.m. and 4 p.m. October 18, 1937, some one hundred persons held a meeting in the Chinese Y.M.C.A., no.999 Bubbling Well Road, in commemoration of the death of Loo Sing, a noted novelist and writer on proletarian subjects. Mr. Tai Van Ping (戴平万), a member of the Shanghai War Time Literature and Art Society, presided and addressed the attendance stating that the meeting had a very important meaning to every one, as it was held at the moment when China's territory was being subjected to heavy bombardment by artillery and aircraft of the enemy. He also urged those present to continue to struggle in the same spirit as the deceased had done for the realization of the emancipation of the nation. Madame Loo Sing nee Hsu Kwang Ping (许广平), then took the chair and related to the audience that all through his life, Mr. Loo Sing had always advocated the organization of a united front to resist foreign aggression and at present his aims were being put into effect. Speeches in a similar strain were delivered by the following:-
Mr. Dien Han (田汉), a left-wing writer and a dramatist.
Mr. Kuo Mo Ju (郭沫若), a left-wing writer, representing the Cultural Circles Race Salvation Association.
Mr. Zung Tseng Toh (郑振铎), a professor of the Government Chinan University and a writer.
Mr. Zung Wan-dao (章望道), a writer.
Mr. Voong Sih Feng (冯雪峰), a writer.
At the conclusion of the meeting the attendance, directed by members of the People's National Salvation Choral Movement Society (with offices at the Sing Hwa Art College, Route Pere Robert), sang the following songs:-

日期 ____ 1937年10月19日。
主题 ____ 纪念已故左翼作家鲁迅（Loo Sing）逝世。
由书记员廖仲谦（Liao Chung Chien）撰写    转呈 [签名]

1937年10月18日下午1时30分至4时之间，约一百人在静安寺路999号中华基督教青年会举行集会，纪念著名小说家及无产阶级题材作家鲁迅（Loo Sing）的逝世。上海战时文艺协会成员戴平万（Tai Van Ping）先生担任主席并向与会者致辞，指出此次集会对每个人都具有极其重要的意义，因为此时中国领土正遭受敌军炮火和飞机的猛烈轰炸。他还敦促在场人士继承逝者的精神，继续为实现民族解放而斗争。随后，鲁迅夫人许广平（Hsu Kwang Ping）女士主持会议，并向听众讲述鲁迅先生一生始终倡导组织统一战线以抵抗外国侵略，而目前他的目标正在得以实现。以下人士发表了类似主旨的演讲：
田汉（Dien Han）先生，左翼作家及剧作家。
郭沫若（Kuo Mo Ju）先生，左翼作家，代表文化界救亡协会。
郑振铎（Zung Tseng Toh）先生，国立暨南大学教授及作家。
章望道（Zung Wan-dao）先生，作家。
冯雪峰（Voong Sih Feng）先生，作家。
会议结束时，在民众救国合唱运动社（社址位于拉都路新华艺术专科学校）成员的指挥下，与会人员演唱了以下歌曲：

pages.en:
Translation

Loo Sing Memorial Song

Your pen is similar to a spear which has penetrated
the head of the "Old China" and caused her
to awaken.
Your voice which is like the sound of a "morning
bell" has awaken the slave classes from their
dreams.
You have never retrated from the struggle for the
emancipation of the nation, but have always
been holding a brilliant flag marching forward
in the front of the "New China."
Oh! Our Guardian and Comrade! Although you have
died, your spirit is alive and will ever remain
with us.
You can have a rest now because we will carry out
the remaining part for you. We will, too,
one day stand before your tomb to report to
you that your aim has been attained by your
comrades.
pages.zh:
译文

鲁迅纪念歌

你的笔如同一支长矛，刺穿了
“旧中国”的头颅，并使她
觉醒。
你的声音如同“晨钟”之声，唤醒了
奴隶阶级，使他们从梦中
惊醒。
你从未在争取民族解放的斗争中
退缩，而是始终高举光辉的旗帜，
走在“新中国”的前列。
哦！我们的守护者和同志！虽然你已
逝世，但你的精神永存，并将永远
与我们同在。
你现在可以安息了，因为我们将为你
完成未竟的事业。我们也将在
某一天站在你的墓前，向你报告
你的同志们已实现了你的目标。

October 16, 1937. | Afternoon Translation.

Lih Pao and other local newspapers:

LATE MR. LU SIN TO BE COMMEMORATED

At a joint meeting held by various youths'
national salvation associations yesterday, the following
resolutions were passed:-
1) That a mammoth service in memory of the late Mr. Lu
Sin ( 魯迅 ), a noted Chinese writer, be held.
2) That contributions of cotton vests in memory of the late
writer be solicited from the public.
3) That a "Committee to Commemorate the late Mr. Lu Sin"
be formed, with offices at the premises of the Youths'
National Salvation Service Group, to take up the necessary
preparations for the above matters.

In memory of the late writer, the Shanghai War-
time Literature and Art Association will hold a meeting
at the Women's Y.M.C.A., Moulsin Road, at 1 p.m. October
18, when Mrs. Lu Sin, nee Hsu Kwang-ping ( 許廣平 ),
will give a lecture on the life of her husband and an
exhibition of manuscripts of writings of Mr. Lu Sin will
be held.
October 19 being the anniversary of the death of
Mr. Lu Sin, various local bodies are making preparations
for commemoration.

（左侧手写批注及印章：X / m3 / 8 OCT）
（下方手写批注：Goo Ch / G 5/10 / S.I. / Even proceedings. / OBR 18/10.）

1937年10月16日。 | 下午译文。

《立报》及其他本地报纸：

将纪念已故鲁迅先生

在昨日由各青年救国会举行的联席会议上，通过了以下决议：
1) 举行盛大仪式，纪念中国著名作家已故鲁迅（魯迅）先生。
2) 向公众募集棉背心，以纪念这位已故作家。
3) 成立“纪念已故鲁迅先生委员会”，办事处设在青年救国服务团 premises（此处指处所/办公地），负责上述事项的必要准备工作。

为纪念这位已故作家，上海战时文艺协会将于10月18日下午1时在慕尔鸣路女青年会举行会议，届时鲁迅夫人许广平（許廣平）女士将发表关于其丈夫生平的演讲，并举办鲁迅先生手稿展览。
10月19日是鲁迅先生逝世周年纪念日，各本地团体正在筹备纪念活动。

（左侧手写批注及印章：X / m3 / 10月8日）
（下方手写批注：Goo Ch / G 10月5日 / S.I. / 甚至 proceedings（程序/过程）。/ OBR 10月18日。）
